bull.b: Near-zero debt-to-equity reduces financial distress and interest burdens, preserving flexibility to fund development or absorb setbacks. However, this strength reflects balance-sheet resilience rather than proof of operating profitability.

The Merck collaboration adds external validation and provides no-cost pembrolizumab for combination development. It broadens support for PSV359, although efficacy and commercial value still depend on clinical trial results.

Multiple 212Pb programs across neuroendocrine tumors, melanoma and FAP-alpha solid tumors create clinical optionality. Regional production, direct-to-hospital delivery and intellectual property could support scalable supply and differentiation.

bear.b: Very small and volatile revenue indicates the company has not yet established a reliable commercial base. The sharp TTM decline, following periods with no reported revenue, leaves future growth dependent primarily on successful clinical and product development.

Persistent net and operating losses show that the current cost structure is far ahead of commercial scale. Without meaningful revenue growth or improved margins, ongoing losses can consume shareholder capital and limit the company’s ability to self-fund expansion.

Sustained negative operating and free cash flow indicates that development and operating outflows materially exceed internally generated funds. Unless profitability improves, continued cash consumption may require additional financing and constrain long-term capital allocation.
